Name: Wraith (Watanabe)
Description: Captain Yuri Watanabe rose through the ranks with Jean DeWolff and under Captain George Stacy. Years later, she was on the scene to make arrests at a known bar occupied by supervillains, that had been broken up by Spider-Man and Daredevil. She later investigated a gangwar between the Maggia (which had Mysterio pulling the strings of a Silvermane robot) and Mr. Negative 's Inner Demons. She was also on the scenes of Phil Urich as the new Hobgoblin's latest attacks, including the attack on Horizon Labs.
